name: force_motors
description: Force motors with 10 times the standard force limits: the brain sets each joint's force, loose at 0
notes: Duck 4. The same strength as ten_times_stronger (Duck 3.3), but with no spring: Duck 3.3's 10 times stiffer position motors made his legs rigid, and asked for 2 m/s he ran about 1.5 to 1.6 m/s. Here the brain's command is the force itself, so a leg is as stiff or as loose as the brain makes it.
